title: mitracarpus megapotamicus
intro: Mitracarpus megapotamicus, commonly known as "Vinho de Pedra" or "Rock Wine," is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mitracarpus megapotamicus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit bronchodilatory effects, making it a potential treatment for asthma and other respiratory conditions. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
